tables.totals_check: No totals printed in this table; the summary table on page 41 gives counts per agency. Counts of passed items here agree with it: Boards of Cabinet 23 items less 2 Not Passed = 21 (items 1-5 on PDF page 35 not recounted, assumed 5 passed); Agriculture 17 less 2 = 15; Commerce 4; Communications 3; Finance 63 less 1 = 62; Home Affairs 9; Justice 23; Transportation 9 less 1 = 8; Welfare 21; House of Representatives 12 less 4 = 8; House of Councillors 0.
warnings: Section headings (ministry names) are given as rows with empty date cells; table began on PDF page 35 (printed page 59) with Boards of Cabinet items 1-5, not transcribed here.
Some printed dates are chronologically odd or impossible but copied as printed, e.g. '31 Sep' (Finance 52, Transportation 7 gives '31 Nov'), H. C. passage before H. R. passage in several rows.
Where 'Not Passed' is printed it sits under or between the H. R. column; placed in H. R. column (H. C. column for Transportation 9 and the House of Councillors rows, where it sits under H. C.).
tables.ocr_check: OCR matched the dates; it misread 'Unjust Claims' as 'Unjust Clinics' (Cabinet 17) and 'Deconcentration' as 'Reconcentration' (Finance 29), and omitted nothing else material.
